title: Metrics Selector
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners match four business questions about story impact to the right metric family: engagement, retention, conversion, or pipeline velocity.

learningObjectives: Select appropriate story impact metrics (Engagement, Retention, Conversion, Pipeline Velocity) for different business objectives.
prerequisites: Story Impact Metrics section of Chapter 9

keyQuestions: Select appropriate story impact metrics (Engagement, Retention, Conversion, Pipeline Velocity) for different business objectives.
commonMisconceptions: One metric tells the whole story.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct metric for all four objectives.
Learner can explain the difference between conversion and pipeline velocity.
